_comment: Every deployable folder and its Netlify site name. All sites are deployed by .github/workflows/release.yml with the Netlify CLI (Git builds are switched off with ignore = "exit 0" in each netlify.toml). A folder in apps/ that is missing here gets <folder>2; if that name is taken the release stops instead of inventing one, so choose a free name before adding an app (scripts/new-app.mjs does this).
